Leonardo.Ai, measured

Every colour on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. Marketing and the signed-out app paint one dark canvas (#0a0a0a, violet #6e60ee). The header toggle switches the docs data-color-mode roles. Product brand names do not switch. The real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Read from leonardo.ai, app.leonardo.ai and docs.leonardo.ai on 2026-11-18, signed out. canvaSans, ufficioDisplay, leoSans and leoRenaisans are Leonardo's own faces and are not loaded here.

Colour

Product roles: page #0a0a0a, surface #171717, text #fafafa, accent #6e60ee. Docs roles (color.docs.*) are the only names that switch with the header toggle. The purple ramp and brand colours sit in core and stay put.

Ramps

Named colours and the purple ramp, declared once. A colour that is also a group (purple, accent, neon) keeps its own value on base so the steps are not dropped.

Typography

canvaSans is the UI face. ufficioDisplay is the marketing wordmark, leoSans the marketing display, leoRenaisans the app display. The declared size scale is 12 to 32px. The live heroes are larger than that scale (measured on the pages).

Density, space and shape

Radius comes from --radius (0.625rem) and the pill --radius-full. Spacing is one declared unit, --spacing at 0.25rem. Generate and the OAuth buttons measure about 32.5px tall.

Radius

Elevation

Focus on the product is --ring, violet at half opacity. The measured controls often show no extra ring on keyboard focus. That is the reading, not a missing token.

Motion

Declared easings and the default duration. Click a track to play it on its own curve.

Layout

The signed-out app shell: a dark canvas, a white display heading, and a prompt about 668 px wide. Generate sits at the right of that bar, 97 by 32.5 px. The full pages are in screenshots/app-dark-default.png.
